endorsements.quote: For example, due to the increasing complexity of AI/ML components, it may be helpful to formally require serious adverse event reporting for medical devices instead of voluntary submission(s).

unlisted_practices: Add LDT error rates, never events, and adverse events to AHRQ Quality and Patient Safety Indicators.
Strengthen FDA medical device recall and MAUDE databases to better track outcome data on device adverse events, never events, and serious malfunctions.
Differentiate AI/ML algorithmic clinical risk predictions from laboratory and organizational data analytics used for aggregate benchmarks.
Modernize CLIA to strengthen analytical and clinical validity coverage for advanced laboratory developed procedures such as NGS.
Optimize the NCBI Genetic Testing Registry to capture voluntary information on LDT safety, quality, adverse events, and AI/ML and clinical decision support use.

screen.reason: This is a policy brief analyzing regulatory considerations and providing recommendations for laboratory developed tests (LDTs) using AI/ML in precision medicine.
